errors.evidence: The description claims the y-axis has no explicit units, but the axis label is clearly "Euro / MW".
For the blue line (EU 0,2 Eurocent/kWh), the starting value in 2025 is approximately 107,000 Euro/MW, not 110,000 Euro/MW.
For the blue line (EU 0,2 Eurocent/kWh), the ending value in 2039 is approximately 94,000 Euro/MW, not 90,000 Euro/MW.
For the green line (EU 0,3 Eurocent/kWh), the starting value in 2025 is approximately 105,000 Euro/MW, not 100,000 Euro/MW.
For the green line (EU 0,3 Eurocent/kWh), the ending value in 2039 is approximately 61,000 Euro/MW, not 80,000 Euro/MW.

errors.text_span: Eine schwarze, durchgezogene Linie, die mit 110.000 Euro/MW bei 2025 beginnt und bei 60.000 Euro/MW bei 2039 endet, stellt die Produktionskosten für China dar.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the black line to "China". The black line represents "EU (Bonushöhe: 0,4 Eurocent / kWh)", while the line for "China" is purple.
For the black line (EU 0,4 Eurocent/kWh), the starting value in 2025 is approximately 106,000 Euro/MW, not 110,000 Euro/MW.
The description completely omits the fourth data series, the purple line representing the production costs for "China".
